name: Camp Twin Hills
operator_name: Girl Scouts of the Green and White Mountains
description_short: A Girl Scout day camp on 184 wooded acres in Richmond, between Burlington and Montpelier, for girls entering kindergarten through 10th grade. Theme weeks mix crafts, science and fantasy with camp favorites like hiking, campfire cooking and sing alongs, and older girls can train as program aides or counselors in training.
notes: Summer 2027 registration opens December 16, 2026 at 7am. Campers must be Girl Scouts; non-members buy a membership when registering. Register by the 2026 to 27 school year grade. Drop off 8:30 to 8:45am, pick up 4 to 5pm, or ride a bus for an added fee. Family night on Tuesdays 4 to 5:30pm. A $100 non-refundable deposit is part of each price. Program Aide service hours weeks cost $200; the two week Counselor in Training program for grades 9 to 10 costs $600. Financial aid (campership) and program credits are for council members.
